# Flight rebooking: compliance and scope

| Ref | Obligation |
|---|---|
| C1 | Passengers must be refunded within seven days when a flight is cancelled, under the Air Passenger Charter. |

## Backlog

US-1 As a passenger, I want my refund for a cancelled flight within seven days so that I am not out of pocket.
US-2 As a passenger, I want to see delay updates so that I can plan my day.
US-3 As a passenger, I want to rebook onto the next flight so that I still get there.
constraints: Passengers must be refunded within seven days when a flight is cancelled, under the Air Passenger Charter.
